name: PyTorch Dev Container (ARM64/M1)
postCreateCommand: cd /workspaces/diffusion && UV_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.org/simple UV_INDEX_STRATEGY=first-index uv sync --refresh && echo 'source /workspaces/diffusion/.venv/bin/activate' >> ~/.bashrc && show-platform
